whisper.transcript: If you put on this backpack, you can have six arms. 4 are robotic and someone else can control them. Researchers in Japan built Gizai Arms, a wearable rig with six sockets for detachable robot limbs. Move a miniature controller and the full-sized arm follows. That means another person can move the extra hand on your back while your real hands stay still. They even demonstrated people removing their robotic arms and swapping them. So now, borrowing someone's arm doesn't have to be a figure of speech.
